scope.fieldsRead: Every stem, four options, key, explanation, all wrong feedback, card front/answer/explanation/source in DE/EN/FA; four learning goals and mappings. Actual lesson goals, four chapters, inline assessment with all option feedback, summary, references and related caveats/notes compared.

SRC.evidence: Fresh primary cohort, original diagnostic consensus and official guideline passages directly support the four assessed decisions; retained PDF/case claims not newly accepted.

EDU.evidence: Four observable goals have actual retrieval mappings; concise self-contained clinical stems and standalone cards; differential options or competing investigation strategies have specific feedback.

VIS.evidence: No question/card requires an absent stimulus. Existing diagnostic lesson figures and PDF82–84 were not re-opened.

LNG.evidence: All four question/card triads and related active teaching clauses compared; no meaning-changing omission, key reversal, numerical mismatch or wrong-language block found. FA nonexpansile wording is understandable in context; could receive later idiomatic polishing without changing the clinical claim.

ASM.evidence: 16/16 current producer objects exactly equal manifest. Original 3 question IDs, keys and option IDs preserved in all languages; fourth question and four cards map to the four goals. Inline FASI question and explanation exactly equal current bank.

UX.evidence: No browser audit by this reviewer. Shared LessonReferenceShell individual optionFeedback consumer is root-owned and requires its own real interaction retest.

REV.evidence: Reviewer did not author NF1 changes and made no production edits.

sources.actualRead: Indexed primary methods, results, biopsy-proven lesion evolution, discussion and conclusion. Direct PMC repeated open returned challenge; indexed full primary text was accessible.
sources.supports: Typical distributions and facilitated diffusion overlap; enhancing lesions may regress; new cysts or second enhancement phase prompted tumour reassessment. Not generalized as a prospective diagnostic performance rule.

sources.actualRead: OPG Table3 and linked discussion; MPNST warning signs and regional MRI/PET/biopsy recommendations. Original published guideline indexed full text also read.
sources.supports: Suspicious visual findings warrant brain/orbital MRI and expert referral. New persistent night pain/accelerated PNF growth warrants regional MRI and specialist workup; PET and sampling are complementary, not blind replacements.

sources.actualRead: Original publisher text: consensus process and features explicitly not incorporated; FASI exclusion.
sources.supports: FASI is not an NF1 diagnostic criterion; revised criteria include genetic/choroidal findings.

sources.actualRead: Actual authors, title, DOI and article type.
sources.supports: Existing review attribution is Russo et al.; not a substitute primary proof for assessment keys.

limitations: Acceptance is for the entire current four-question/four-card pool and its bounded teaching parity, not every NF1 clinical statement or systemic chapter claim.
Retained figures, case selection/attribution and PDF82–84 coverage were not freshly reverified. No new image or rights approval.
Primary sources were read for the assessed claims, not every cited reference end-to-end.
No fresh browser, access-gate, RTL, physician scientific release or published snapshot approval is inferred.
